mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2100 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' profitability improves.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 6-month MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% YoY, the tightening monetary policy and inflation concerns lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical monetary policy and inflation impacts on stock market
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is a persistent indicator of labor market health, with lower values consistently associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, due to the predictive power of labor market indicators on economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly correlated with UNRATE (p > 0.05).

evidence_refs: fact:historical consumer spending and housing market impacts on stock market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
